writing.Task fulfilment: Can convey simple, basic information on familiar topics. Uses short, isolated sentences.
writing.Grammatical accuracy: Shows only limited control of a few simple grammatical structures and sentence patterns.
writing.Lexical resource: Has a basic vocabulary repertoire of isolated words and phrases related to particular concrete situations.

speaking.Task fulfilment: Can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly. Can ask and answer simple questions.
speaking.Grammatical accuracy: Shows only limited control of a few simple grammatical structures and sentence patterns.
speaking.Lexical resource: Has a basic vocabulary repertoire of isolated words and phrases related to particular concrete situations.
speaking.Interactive capability: Can manage very short, isolated, mainly pre-packaged utterances, with much pausing to search for expressions.

writing.Task fulfilment: Can write a series of simple phrases and sentences linked with simple connectors like 'and', 'but' and 'because'.
writing.Grammatical accuracy: Uses some simple structures correctly, but still systematically makes basic mistakes.
writing.Lexical resource: Has sufficient vocabulary to conduct routine, everyday transactions involving familiar situations.

speaking.Task fulfilment: Can communicate in simple and routine tasks requiring a simple and direct exchange of information.
speaking.Grammatical accuracy: Uses some simple structures correctly, but still systematically makes basic mistakes.
speaking.Lexical resource: Has sufficient vocabulary to conduct routine, everyday transactions involving familiar situations.
speaking.Interactive capability: Can answer questions and respond to simple statements. Can indicate when they are following.

writing.Task fulfilment: Can write straightforward connected text on topics which are familiar or of personal interest.
writing.Grammatical accuracy: Communicates with reasonable accuracy in familiar contexts; generally good control though with noticeable mother tongue influence.
writing.Lexical resource: Has a sufficient vocabulary to express themselves with some circumlocutions on most topics pertinent to their everyday life.

speaking.Task fulfilment: Can deal with most situations likely to arise whilst travelling. Can enter unprepared into conversation on familiar topics.
speaking.Grammatical accuracy: Communicates with reasonable accuracy in familiar contexts; generally good control though with noticeable mother tongue influence.
speaking.Lexical resource: Has a sufficient vocabulary to express themselves with some circumlocutions on most topics pertinent to their everyday life.
speaking.Interactive capability: Can start, maintain and close simple face-to-face conversation on topics that are familiar or of personal interest.

writing.Task fulfilment: Can write clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects related to their interests. Can explain a viewpoint on a topical issue.
writing.Grammatical accuracy: Shows a relatively high degree of grammatical control. Does not make errors which cause misunderstanding.
writing.Lexical resource: Has a good range of vocabulary for matters connected to their field and most general topics.

speaking.Task fulfilment: Can interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction with native speakers quite possible.
speaking.Grammatical accuracy: Shows a relatively high degree of grammatical control. Does not make errors which cause misunderstanding.
speaking.Lexical resource: Has a good range of vocabulary for matters connected to their field and most general topics.
speaking.Interactive capability: Can take an active part in informal discussion in familiar contexts, commenting, putting point of view clearly.

writing.Task fulfilment: Can express themselves in clear, well-structured text, expressing points of view at some length.
writing.Grammatical accuracy: Consistently maintains a high degree of grammatical accuracy; errors are rare and difficult to spot.
writing.Lexical resource: Has a good command of a broad lexical repertoire allowing gaps to be readily overcome with circumlocutions.

speaking.Task fulfilment: Can express themselves fluently and spontaneously almost effortlessly. Can use language flexibly and effectively.
speaking.Grammatical accuracy: Consistently maintains a high degree of grammatical accuracy; errors are rare and difficult to spot.
speaking.Lexical resource: Has a good command of a broad lexical repertoire allowing gaps to be readily overcome with circumlocutions.
speaking.Interactive capability: Can select a suitable phrase from a readily available range of discourse functions to preface their remarks in order to get or keep the floor.
